description: Physical operator bindings used by the skillgen operator smoke. Gated operators are bound but not externally executed without approval.

limitations: Local retrieval evidence is checked; explicit model evidence or a model command can supply synthesis, but it is not implied.
Structural smoke runs; explicit model evidence or a model command can supply LLM content-quality review.

Approved runtime digest evidence can complete the route and --write can fan runtime candidates into wiki papers/log/graph; SMTP delivery, direct feed fetch, and scheduling remain approval/provider-gated.
Native seed modes and root discover CLI are supported; unavailable live discovery sources produce inconclusive evidence rather than synthetic candidates.
Keep partial until live/wiki source evidence produces completed shortlist evidence under real provider conditions.
Wiki/raw mutation is not executed without approval; smoke verifies proposed memory-update evidence.

Current experiment design path emits evidence-linked local plans and can attach Review LLM design validation; full parity still requires runtime artifact discovery and end-to-end approved execution audit.

Explicit experiment result, claim, code, and Review LLM evidence can complete review-backed local verdicts; approved --write can update linked wiki status; Review LLM second opinion is not implied by fixture claim verification.
Pilot result/runtime evidence can produce completed lenient verdicts; approved --write can update linked wiki status, while unapproved mutation remains blocked.
Real code/remote pilot execution requires approval; runtime evidence can be supplied or produced by an explicitly allowlisted command.
SSH, rsync, screen, and long-running code require approval; tools/remote.py can execute only explicitly allowlisted commands and emits runtime evidence for verifier consumption.
Wiki run-state, remote.py check, and approved runtime collect evidence are checked; provider-specific remote connectivity remains audit dependent.
Fixture ideas are allowed only in explicit smoke mode; full ideation still needs wiki gaps, external discovery, dual-model generation, novelty/review gates, and banlist filtering.
Skillgen smoke uses local markdown paper input.

Source-grounded PDF extraction, fixture-leakage guards, generic local wiki mutation/rebuild tooling, and publication citation-map handoff are covered; downstream lifecycle/provider audits still keep this binding partial.
Approved runtime source manifests can complete init evidence and --write can fan candidates into wiki papers/log/graph; native network fetch and bulk ingest execution remain approval/provider-gated.
S2 and DeepXiv source CLIs emit explicit provider evidence; unavailable external sources and Review LLM are not implied.
Approved compile can run an allowlisted TeX executor and --fix can replace TeX source from after_artifact evidence; unapproved toolchains stay inconclusive with diagnostics.
Report and LaTeX sidecars are evidence-linked; verified compile/PDF handoff can be attached; wiki-output manuscript synthesis still needs real end-to-end provider/runtime audit.
Citation-map and Review LLM evidence can complete the plan route; verified compile/PDF handoff can be attached; live idea-graph/figure/table planning still keeps this binding partial.
Optional poster HTML is generated; browser rendering/PNG export run only through explicit approved renderer configuration and runtime evidence.
Foundation creation mutates local wiki state only with explicit approval; no-approval runs remain proposal evidence.
Supplied Review LLM findings can complete mapped rebuttal response plans; full reviewer-thread ingestion/submission audit remains partial.
Verified --execute-approved runs can replace a target artifact from after_artifact evidence; quality gate reruns remain approval/provider-gated.
Evidence-aware lifecycle completion is supported when required stage evidence is supplied; human gates and long-running execution are not collapsed into one unapproved black-box operator.
Destructive reset is not executed; only dry-run/proposal evidence is allowed.
Non-smoke /review emits artifact_review.v1 evidence; configured Review LLM provider, command bridge, or supplied Review LLM evidence is required for final acceptance.
Secret writing/configuration is not executed without explicit user-provided values and approval.
Survey completes only with source-backed citation-map evidence; live/exhaustive literature coverage still needs provider-condition audit.
Graph update evidence is produced; Obsidian Canvas/web UI serving is not executed without approval.
